batching_note: Only dispatch size varies to measure request and batch workloads; encoder/model tokenization, precision, max length, normalization and classifier parameters unchanged. Final batch has 2 rows. Batched throughput is not interactive request latency.
execution_order: Batch size 1 then 32. One untimed complete validation warmup for each batching mode, then five timed full validation passes for that mode.
isolation: Install test-file/final-test-artifact and network audit guard before data/model access. No official test open/hash/inference, paid calls, tuning or refitting.
limitations: Single-machine reused-validation CPU measurement; sequential fixed ordering, no concurrent serving/load test, power/thermal conditions uncontrolled. Does not imply cloud price, production latency, total-system savings or free local inference. Existing 1540 training +770 validation labels; no additional labels.
loading: Measure local encoder and classifier loading separately before warmup, excluding artifact hash validation; include lazy encoder-library imports. Filesystem may already be warm; no cold-start guarantee.
memory: Sample process RSS using ps -o rss= (KiB -> bytes) before/after loading and warmup/every pass. Record resource.ru_maxrss process lifetime high water (Darwin bytes). Includes Python/dependencies/evidence; not isolated model allocation or continuous transient RSS.
model: Existing frozen 20-shot seed-11 MiniLM + logistic regression; all encoder/classifier files, package versions, generation-free encoding settings and exact threshold inherited unchanged from EXP-007.
population: Exactly 770 saved v2 validation IDs in original saved order; resolve raw texts only from pinned official training CSV. No test access, new samples or fitting.
summary: Pool 3850 single-request timings for median/p95 (NumPy linear percentile); keep each pass and per-batch duration. Batch throughput=3850/sum inference durations across 5 passes; retain per-pass throughput.
threads: torch intra-op and inter-op threads=1; threadpoolctl native libraries=1; TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false; deterministic torch algorithms; CPU only
timed_path: Preloaded raw text -> tokenization -> frozen CPU float32 MiniLM -> normalization -> LR probabilities -> exact fixed scalar gate. No cached embeddings or predictions. perf_counter_ns around each request/batch only; no network/disk logging/verification inside timer.
verification: Hash pinned files/packages before deserialization; check frozen encoder/classifier state before/after. Compare each pass prediction and exact gate against archived validation probabilities; report all numerical differences and gate changes, without adjusting threshold or forcing coverage.
